videoDetails.title: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next Tested - 16GB Local LLM setup
videoDetails.shortDescription:
In this video I'm looking at Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, a new model from the Qwen team which is using a different approach based on the upcoming Qwen 4 release of models.

I run through a few tests which are:
1. Performance
2. Memory
3. Reasoning
4. OpenAI Human Eval
5. Kanban
6. Sand Physics
7. Dungeon Crawler
8. Blender
9. Godot


If you're interested in local LLMs, AI and homelabs - feel free to subscribe!


Model: https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF
Website: https://lukesdevlab.com/
HumanEval: https://github.com/openai/human-eval
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/LukesDevLab
